PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (15, 10, 20),       # NMOS CS gm/Id (sets gm1 for GBW)
    "L1":    (0.5, 0.15, 1.0),   # NMOS CS length (high intrinsic gain, low gds1)
    "gmid2": (10, 8, 14),        # PMOS load gm/Id (Vdsat2 vs swing trade-off)
    "L2":    (0.15, 0.15, 0.3),  # PMOS load length (sets gds2 -> overall gain)
    "I1":    (55e-6, 40e-6, 60e-6),  # signal-branch current (= load current)
    "IREF":  (5e-6, 2e-6, 8e-6),     # reference current (power: 1.8*(I1+2*IREF) <= 140 uW)
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VDD = 1.8
    cl = spec.get("cl", 5e-13)
    I1, IREF = p["I1"], p["IREF"]

    # Signal path: NMOS common-source (M1) with PMOS current-source load (M2)
    op1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.9)
    op2 = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], I1, vds=0.9)

    # Bias: PMOS diode M3 (pb) carries IREF; M2 mirrors it with the same gm/Id and L
    opr = lut.size("p", p["gmid2"], p["L2"], IREF, vds=0.9)
    # Reference NMOS diode at ibias (M0) and sinking mirror (M4) with the same gm/Id, L and current
    opn = lut.size("n", 10, 1.0, IREF, vds=0.6)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("M1", "vout", "vin", "vss", "vss", op1)     # signal NMOS CS
    n.dev("M2", "vout", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", op2)      # PMOS current-source load
    n.dev("M3", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", opr)        # PMOS diode, sets pb
    n.dev("M4", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", opn)     # NMOS sink mirror: pulls IREF from pb
    n.dev("M0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", opn)  # NMOS diode at ibias (IREF from VDD in)

    # Analytic predictions
    gm1, gds1 = op1.gm, op1.gds
    gds2 = op2.gds
    gain = gm1 / (gds1 + gds2)
    f3db = (gds1 + gds2) / (2 * PI * cl)
    gbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * cl)
    power = VDD * (I1 + 2 * IREF)
    swing = (VDD - op2.vdsat) - op1.vdsat

    return n, {
        "gain_db": db(gain),
        "f3dB": f3db,
        "gbw": gbw,
        "power": power,
        "vout_dc": 0.9,   # balanced by sizing at vds=0.9 for both branches
        "swing": swing,
    }
